case.narrative: The contact owns a 2022 Ford Bronco Sport. The contact received notification of NHTSA Campaign Number: 25V019000 (Electrical System); however, the part to do the recall repair was not yet available. The contact stated that while attempting to accelerate from a stop, the vehicle failed to accelerate while the accelerator pedal was depressed. An unknown message was displayed on the instrument panel. The local dealer was contacted. The contact stated that the manufacturer had exceeded a reasonable amount of time for the recall repair. The manufacturer was made aware of the failure. The failure mileage was approximately 27,000. VIN tool confirms parts not available.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
